spanish: Y hizo el atrio; al lado de Negev, al Temán, colgaduras del atrio de lino fino retorcido, cien en el codo.

findings.issue: Common noun H5045 is rendered as the proper name Negev, closing the open south/region sense.
Common noun H8486 with directional suffix is rendered as the proper name Temán, closing the open southward sense.
Lemma 8336 b and the morph (cardinal feminine singular) leave the sense open; lino fino resolves that as fine linen and adds fineness.

notes: Y hizo el atrio, colgaduras del atrio, retorcido, and cien en el codo match the 3ms qal, both courts, the plural construct, the hophal passive, and the hundred plus singular cubit.
